book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Diyon wana Leleli

content: Yeisu I Awanun Iya Totona kaiwena
Yeisu baaba bolo ya i baunan haba, yaka matana i lihin labulabumwa ge i ba, “Nam, sauga iyaka i vin. Natum nu pawasawasa, inoke Natum ni pawasawasa-agiwa.
Kaiwena gasisi u pek elana gamagalau gegewel ni logugui-agil, inoke bosowaina yawal hot ni pek gamagalau gegewel elal bolo u pek elana.
Ge yawal hot iya te owa Yabowaine tutunahotina maisem nihi atenawa, ge Yeisu Keliso iya u patuna nihi atena.
Iyaka alam ya pawasawasa panayawiya, kaiwena tuwalali toto u pem ge na ginol, iyaka ya pwamowasi.
Nam, he nuwau sauga ya alou owa ta mina ge alau nu pawasawasa, ni ola te valila alou owa ta minaa wasawasa o elana mulaa abwe panayawi i gan.
Yeisu I Awanun wana Tohago kaiweliya
Iyaka ya pamasaliwa gamagalau elal, bolo u aheliya panayawi ge u pem elau. He heliya wam gamagalau ge abwe u pem elau. Inoke wam baaba hi henapuan,
ge iyaka hi atena te bugul gegewena bolo u pem elau hi neem elam.
Baaba bolo u pem eliyau iyaka ya baunan eliyalil, he iyaka hi hago ge hi yaliyaya-an. Inoke hi atena te tunahot nau ya neem elam, ge hi abulilek-an te owa u patunau.
Ya awanun kaiweliya. Nige ya aawanun panayawi gamagaliliyau kaiweliya, yaa bolo u pem elau kaiweliya, kaiwena heliya wam gamagalau.
No gamagalau gegewel heliya wam gamagalau, ge wam gamagalau gegewel heliya al no gamagalau. Ge gamagalau ya elal gamagalau panayawiya no wasawasa hi kite.

He nau ya nonowa elam. Nige na miminaa al panayawi, yaa heliya nihi miminaa ga panayawi. O Nam Bwabwalena, alam wana gasisi elana nu matahikagil—he alan o iyaka u pem elau—inoke nihi tabwa maisena ni ola owa ge nau kila maisena.

Sauga alowau ha mina, alam wana gasisi elana ya matahikagil, he alan o iyaka u pem elau. Ya nolibulibu-agil, inoke nige etega i yayaomal, iyai ya te tau toto nuwana yaomal, inoke Buki Bwabwalena ana baaba i patunahot.
Nau ya nonowa eliyam, yaa sauga nau iyehe panayawi, no awanun o ya baunan, inoke no yaliyaya ateliya ni kalaopopwi.
Wam baaba ya baunan eliyalil, inoke panayawi gamagaliliyau hi pihigelgel-agil, kaiwena nige hi miminek panayawi gamagaliliyau ali boda elana, i ola nau nige ya miminek ali boda elana.
Ya awanun nige tage nu aheliya panayawi, yaa nu nolibulibu-agil Seitani elana.
Heliya nige hi miminek panayawi gamagaliliyau ali boda elana, i ola nau nige ya miminek panayawi ali boda elana.
Wam baaba i tunahot, inoke nuwau wam baaba tutunahotina ni tuwalaliya elal ge eliyana nu pwabwabwalena-agil wam tuwalali kaiwena.
Ya patunal hi tagil panayawi i ola u patunau ya nem panayawi.
Heliya kaiweliya ya pwabwabwalena-agau elam, kaiwena nuwau heliya al nihi bwabwalena hot elam.
Yeisu I Awanun Bolo Abwe Nihi Abulilek kaiweliya
Nige ya aawanun ya te bolo ya kaiweliya, yaa ya awanun al bolo tohago ya wali wasa eliyana ge abwe nihi abulilek elau kaiweliya.

Ya awanun te heliya gegewel nihi tabwa maisena. O Nam, nihi minaa eliyala ni ola te owa u minaa elau ge nau ya minaa elam. Nihi tabwa maisena inoke panayawi gamagaliliyau nihi abulilek-an te owa u patunau.
Iyaka u pawasawasa-agau, inoke wasawasa o eliyana nau iyaka ya pawasawasa-agil, inoke heliya nihi tabwa maisena ni ola owa ge nau kila maisena.
Nau ya minaa elal ge owa u minaa elau, inoke ginol o eliyana nuwau heliya nihi tabwa maisena hot. Yaka panayawi nihi atena te owa u patunau ge bolo o u nunuwana-agil i ola u nunuwana-agau.
Nam, bolo u pem elau, nuwau alowau naha mipamaisena labi toto nau na minaa, inoke no wasawasa nihi kite. He wasawasa o u pem elau kaiwena u nunuwana-agau mulaa abwe panayawi i gan.
Nam, Tosasapona hot owa, panayawi nige hi aatenawa, yaa nau ya atenawa, ge bolo u pem elau iyaka hi atena te owa u patunau.
Iyaka ya pamasaliwa elal, ge na ginol hikahikani, kaiwena nuwau nihi penununuwana-agil ni ola owa u nunuwana-agau, ge nuwau al na minaa elal.”
